visualCharacteristics.structure: stacked pill rows: calendar icon | date above title | 'Add (+)' action panel on the right

contentPattern: Repeating event rows: one row per event, cell 1 date (dd/mm/yyyy, e.g. 28/10/2026), cell 2 event title, optional cell 3 description. Renders as a stacked list with a calendar icon, date and title; the 'Add' action builds an all-day .ics file client-side (Blob download) from the row's date and title.
